reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: "I'm really impressed with this clay mask. The texture is smooth and easy to spread, and it doesn't dry out my skin like other mud masks. It does a great job of drawing out impurities from my pores without causing any irritation. My skin feels clean, refreshed, and the pores look visibly minimized after use. Highly recommend for a gentle yet effective cleanse!"
reviews.zh: 我對呢款泥膜真係好驚喜。質地滑順、容易推開，而且唔似其他泥膜咁會抽乾皮膚水分。佢能夠有效吸出毛孔入面嘅污垢，過程中完全冇刺激感。用完之後皮膚感覺清爽乾淨，毛孔明顯細緻咗。溫和但清潔力強，超推薦！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: smaller than i thought. only tried once and wasn't too impressed. i'll try a few more times and update my review later. don't recall being irritating on my skin so that's a good thing.
reviews.zh: 比我想像中細。用咗一次，印象一般。我會再用多幾次，之後再更新評價。冇印象對皮膚造成刺激，呢點算係好嘅。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: I really don't like the scent but it's nice and it's great that it works quickly and you don't have to wait for 10-15 mins like you usually have to with clay masks
reviews.zh: 味道我真係接受唔到，但整體唔錯，而且最棒嘅係佢起效快，唔使好似一般泥膜咁等成 10-15 分鐘。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: I have oily skin, and this product left my skin feeling hydrated. It doesn’t have a noticeable smell, but I appreciate how cooling it feels. I also have sensitive skin, and it hasn’t caused any irritation so far. I’ll continue using it and see how my skin reacts.
reviews.zh: 我係油性肌，用完之後皮膚感覺好保濕。冇乜明顯氣味，但我幾鍾意佢涼涼哋嘅感覺。我同時有敏感肌，暫時都冇引起刺激。我會繼續用落去，睇下皮膚反應點。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: This product is one that I have used frequently since Korea, and it is also a popular product in Korea and has a high ranking, so I bought it. I am using it often because I am concerned about blackheads, and it seems to have good cleansing power and effects, so I will keep using it and see.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品我喺韓國已經用過好多次，喺當地都係人氣產品、排名好高，所以我就買咗。我成日用係因為有黑頭煩惱，睇落清潔力同效果都唔錯，會繼續用落去觀察。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: Mình đặt hàng trên app giao qua nhật gần 3 tuần mới tới nơi. Mình da mụn viêm dùng vẫn được không bị rát với khô da rửa mặt xong cảm giác mềm. M mua cả bộ gồm srm , dầu ttr, mask trả tiền qua thẻ hết 850k thấy giá quá oki rồi.
reviews.zh: 我喺 app 落單寄去日本，差唔多 3 個禮拜先到。我係發炎暗瘡肌，用完都冇刺痛，洗面之後皮膚都唔會覺得乾，摸落軟軟哋。我買咗成個套裝，包括洗面奶、卸妝油、面膜，碌卡畀咗 85 萬越南盾，覺得個價錢真係超抵。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text: Love this stuff!!!! When I wash it off my face feels dry like it took all the oil out and makes my face feel ready for the moisturizer that follows! I have acne prone skin and this has helped so much! Can’t wait to order more!
reviews.zh: 勁鍾意呢款產品！！！！沖水之後塊面會覺得乾爽，感覺成面油都被吸走，之後即刻可以搽保濕霜！我係容易生暗瘡嘅膚質，呢款幫咗我好大忙！已經急不及待想再訂！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clay Mask Pack 120mL (+12mL*4ea Special Set)
reviews.text:
I see the hype for this clay mask. I've used it a couple times already and it does leave the pores on my nose very clean and doesn't dry or leave my skin feeling tight. I leave it on for 4 minutes and then use a bit water to exfoliate it around my nose wash it completely of and I'm done. It's also quite refreshing.
Would repurchase it. I also recommend!
reviews.zh: 呢款泥膜嘅熱度我明。我已經用過幾次，敷完之後鼻上毛孔真係清得好乾淨，皮膚又唔會覺得乾或者繃緊。我敷 4 分鐘，跟住用少少水喺鼻周圍輕輕按摩去角質，再徹底沖洗就搞掂。感覺好清爽。會回購，誠意推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
